# F&M Paint

> Premium exterior house painting company serving Edmond, Yukon, Oklahoma City, Bethany, The Village, Piedmont, and surrounding Oklahoma communities.

F&M Paint is a veteran and family-owned painting company focused mainly on premium exterior house painting, painted brick homes, siding painting, trim painting, fence staining, exterior prep, and full exterior transformations. The company is based in Piedmont, Oklahoma, but serves homeowners throughout the Oklahoma City metro, with Edmond and Yukon as primary service areas.
